controls.title: Logical access security
controls.summary: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures to protect information assets from unauthorized access. Cloud IAM must enforce least privilege and strong authentication. (Summary authored by ComplianceIQ.)
references: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria CC6.1 — consult the licensed criteria for normative text

controls.title: Boundary protection
controls.summary: The entity implements controls to protect against threats from sources outside its system boundaries, such as firewalls and restricted network exposure. Publicly reachable administrative services violate this criterion. (Summary authored by ComplianceIQ.)
references: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria CC6.6 — consult the licensed criteria for normative text

controls.title: Data transmission and encryption
controls.summary: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information and protects it using encryption. Data at rest and in transit in cloud services must be encrypted. (Summary authored by ComplianceIQ.)
references: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria CC6.7 — consult the licensed criteria for normative text

controls.title: Security monitoring
controls.summary: The entity monitors system components for anomalies indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors. Cloud audit logging and continuous monitoring are required. (Summary authored by ComplianceIQ.)
references: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria CC7.2 — consult the licensed criteria for normative text
